surface: mocked portal validation vs live public booking detail on http://localhost:3000

assertionResults.reason: The shared booking-detail model is confirmed in deterministic code/test coverage, but the required user-surface comparison is not executable from the available mocked portal/live harnesses: both /bookings/booking-1 and /guest/bookings/booking-1 redirect to sign-in on the live surface, and no mocked authenticated portal harness exists for /guest/bookings/[bookingId] to render the guest booking-detail page for the same fixture identity.

deterministicCoverage: tests/guest/public-booking-pages.test.tsx confirms the guest route reuses the shared booking-detail page model.
src/app/(public)/bookings/booking-page.tsx and src/app/guest/bookings/[bookingId]/page.tsx show the shared ReservationDetailClient/BookingDetailPage implementation.

frictions.description: The mission guidance allows mocked portal validation for /guest/dashboard, /guest/bookings, and /guest/profile, but it does not provide an equivalent mocked authenticated harness for /guest/bookings/[bookingId].

blockers.description: No executable user-surface path is available to open public and guest booking-detail pages for one coherent mocked portal fixture without relying on real shared auth state.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Compared the live public and guest booking-detail routes in agent-browser and reviewed deterministic shared-model coverage in the route/test files; both live routes redirected to sign-in and no detail-specific mocked harness was available.

summary: VAL-CROSS-003 is blocked for user-surface validation: deterministic code/tests confirm public and guest routes share one booking-detail model, but the available mocked portal surface does not expose /guest/bookings/[bookingId] and the live public/guest routes both redirect to sign-in instead of rendering comparable detail views.
